notes:
# OFMtouch v0.6.9 — Season Economy Fixes

- Season prizes for generated divisions scale with their recurring income, preventing small leagues from receiving oversized payouts. Authored worlds retain their own prize rules.
- Promotion restores wage budget capacity reduced by relegation.
- Sponsor position bonuses and forecasts use the correct domestic league standings, including competition-based leagues.
- Release highlights are translated into all 12 languages. Previous patch notes remain available.

Android ARM64 · Build 358 · version code 6900358.

The original package and signing certificate are retained for updates over the previous signed build.

Matching source commit: `719c848c8e62ef8080adb16d04bbd09587c21e52`.

Validation: 1,649 frontend tests and 2,155 Rust workspace tests passed (two existing ignored tests), strict lint and formatting checks passed, and all six GitHub regression gates passed. Five-year isolated cash-flow tests cover six club sizes; full career balance and physical-device gameplay were not tested. Android build, original signature, package, version, ARM64 payload and alignment verified.

Thank you for playing OFMtouch and helping improve it by reporting issues.

Thanks, TranquilMT
